meaning: Directed links describe research provenance, analytical dependencies and review requirements; they do not establish causal effects.

nodes.label:
Pressure
identification
nodes.summary: Which environmental pressures are supported at the study location and scale?
nodes.scope: Regional climate context and local records; pressure alone does not determine a rotation.
nodes.limit: A climate resemblance class is not a measured field stress or crop-suitability probability.

nodes.label:
Rotation-function
matching
nodes.summary: Which cover, nitrogen, root or sequence functions fit local soil, water and operations?
nodes.scope: Agronomic functions must be checked against management, equipment and markets.
nodes.limit: A crop label or historic system contrast does not isolate a crop-function effect.

nodes.label:
Fair strategy
comparison
nodes.summary: How can the current rotation and at least two alternatives be compared on common physical and economic supports?
nodes.scope: Separate observed trials, process diagnostics and historical financial estimates.
nodes.limit: A model diagnostic or point-estimate financial order is not an operational recommendation.

nodes.label:
Scale and
uncertainty
nodes.summary: How sensitive are conclusions to data support, missing inputs and assumptions?
nodes.scope: Native resolution, depth mapping, time splits, PTF and initial-water assumptions remain explicit.
nodes.limit: Scenario ranges are not confidence intervals; repeated plot dates do not create independent weather years.

nodes.label:
Farmer trade-offs
and review
nodes.summary: How should farmer priorities shape a transparent discussion while retaining local expertise?
nodes.scope: Resource constraints, market outlets, costs and adviser review.
nodes.limit: Real farmer usability participants remain zero; preferences do not validate a model.

nodes.label:
NASA environment
and climate context
nodes.summary: NASA POWER supplies regional forcing and climate context. The national table separates POWER samples, IDW fill and study anchors.
nodes.scope: 3,107 county records; 3,098 outlines. Other NASA resources considered are not automatically admitted as model inputs.
nodes.limit: Regional or interpolated information is not field-station ground truth.

nodes.label:
Observed trials
and county yields
nodes.summary: Marsden plot records, PFI treatment summaries and USDA county observations support comparisons at different scales.
nodes.scope: Plot, farm-strip summary and county aggregate evidence are kept separate.
nodes.limit: Raw PFI strip/sensor data are unavailable; county yields cannot verify individual field management.

nodes.label:
Soil and
management logs
nodes.summary: Measured 2014 soil layers and original operation logs improve input traceability and resolve major nitrogen-basis errors.
nodes.scope: Eight 0–100 cm profiles, 40 layers and 1,168 source log clusters, including 40 date conflicts.
nodes.limit: Measured retention, dated initial states, drainage and a complete unique event ledger remain open.

nodes.label:
Farmer conditions
and priorities
nodes.summary: Water, equipment, crop use, oat outlets and the discussion priority can be entered in this demo.
nodes.scope: Temporary page inputs, not independently checked farm records.
nodes.limit: No actual farmer usability results are supplied.

nodes.label:
Costs, buyers
and macro scenarios
nodes.summary: Historical budget estimates provide context. Current buyer terms and full incremental field accounts are prerequisites for decision appraisal.
nodes.scope: Prices, climate, policy or trade shocks may be explicit scenarios.
nodes.limit: No verified event probabilities, geopolitical causal effects or current farm profit forecast are claimed.

nodes.label:
Units, support
and harmonization
nodes.summary: Preserve spatial and temporal support, normalize grain moisture basis and map soil-water depths transparently.
nodes.scope: Regional climate, trial observations, soil horizons and county data retain separate meanings.
nodes.limit: Resampling or a unit conversion cannot create new ground observations.

nodes.label:
Agronomic rules
and constraints
nodes.summary: Check water, establishment, termination, crop use and market constraints before discussing alternatives.
nodes.scope: Current corn–soybean plus rye and oats/red-clover discussion options; ROTOR/CropRota inform the constraint concept.
nodes.limit: Unknowns stay unknown; a high score cannot offset an unavailable machine or missing buyer.

nodes.label:
Rust replay
and holdout checks
nodes.summary: An independent simplified water–C–N model and separate historical tests expose process and transfer errors.
nodes.scope: 32 source-driven field runs; temporal and leave-one-year-out county diagnostics.
nodes.limit: Not official APSIM; conservation and fitting are not independent predictive validation.

nodes.label:
CBA, MCA
and sensitivity
nodes.summary: Compare full-cycle incremental accounts, physical criteria and farmer-defined preferences after feasibility checks.
nodes.scope: Historical financial estimates and declared price sensitivities are available; full field CBA and MCA are not.
nodes.limit: Missing costs are not zero. Grid-case counts are not probabilities or a farmer ranking.

nodes.label:
E3 · Field replay
yield / water bias

E4 · County crop
and product context

Independent
validation gate
nodes.summary: Independent effect validation must establish adequate water, phenology, yield and rotation-difference performance.
nodes.scope: Full-cycle, multi-year evidence with declared baselines and support.
nodes.limit: Current field replay bias and county transfer limits prevent operational model claims.

nodes.label:
Local feasibility
and accounts gate
nodes.summary: Confirm real water and operations, complete incremental costs and a usable outlet before appraisal.
nodes.scope: Current farm conditions, buyer terms and comparable cycle accounts.
nodes.limit: Historic system means do not replace verified local feasibility or a full CBA.

nodes.label:
Farmer / adviser
review gate
nodes.summary: Farmers and local advisers review evidence, uncertainty and priorities before testing a change.
nodes.scope: Human judgment and a real field trial remain part of the research design.
nodes.limit: No operational recommendation rank is issued; actual farmer usability participants remain zero.
